semantic_version.description: Specify specifying version range for semantic-release. If no version range is specified, latest version will be used by default

branches.description: The branches on which releases should happen. It will override the branches attribute in your configuration file. Support for semantic-release above v16. See ht

branch.description: The branch on which releases should happen. It will override the branch attribute in your configuration file. If the attribute is not configured on both sides,

extra_plugins.description: Extra plugins for pre-install. You can also specify specifying version range for the extra plugins if you prefer.

dry_run.description: Whether to run semantic release in `dry-run` mode. It will override the dryRun attribute in your configuration file

ci.description: Whether to run semantic release with CI support (default: true). It will override the ci attribute in your configuration file

unset_gha_env.description: Whether to unset the GITHUB_ACTIONS environment variable. This can be useful when trying to run semantic-release as part of PR checks.

working_directory.description: Specify another working directory for semantic release. Default one is provided by github.

tag_format.description: The default tag format on semantic-release is v{version}. You can override that behavior using this option.

repository_url.description: The Git repository url. If no repository url specified, current repository will be used by default.
